title: Cursed Fate: Custom Open Domain Compatibility
description: Allows custom addon CT open domains to register as real Cursed Fate open domains
body:
Makes open domains built with Voidcrawler's public custom open domain template register with Cursed Fate's normal open domain checks.

Without this, those domains can still run their own visuals and effects, but Cursed Fate does not see them as real open domains. That means nearby base domains may ignore them, and closed domains can be opened inside them.

With this installed serverside, the template's CustomOpenDomain data is picked up by Cursed Fate's open domain detection, so template-based domains can block nearby base domain expansions the same way the base mod's open domains do.

If you use a different template and still want to use this mod, make sure it uses the same CustomOpenDomain tag and it will register automatically.

Works automatically for any addons using the template, which can be found in the Cursed Fate Addon Hub Discord's addon-guide channel.

Serverside mod.
